name: google
description: Connect Google accounts via OAuth2 (Gmail + Calendar scopes). Tokens live in the vault; the connector hands out valid access tokens and refreshes them automatically.
env_example: # Create an OAuth client in Google Cloud Console (OAuth consent +
# 'Desktop app' credentials). Add the Gmail/Calendar scopes you need.
# Where Google redirects after consent. For local testing use the
# platform's published port; it must exactly match the redirect URI
post_install: Restart the platform: docker compose restart endpoint-platform (applies 018_google.sql, hot-loads the app).
Set GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID / GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET in .env (Google Cloud Console -> APIs & Services -> Credentials).
Connect an account: GET /api/google/auth/start?email=you@gmail.com&scopes=gmail,calendar — open the returned URL, approve, and the callback stores the tokens in the vault.
A 30-minute job keeps access tokens fresh; connectors.google.google_request() also refreshes lazily on 401.
